title: Bayer ships HIV-contaminated hemophilia medicine abroad

tellings.quote: you go just back to the 80s where they knowingly shipped a massive amount of hemophilia medications that were infected with HIV into third world countries.

plain: In the 1980s, the story goes, the drug company Bayer knowingly shipped large amounts of medicine for hemophilia, a disorder that stops blood from clotting, that was infected with HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, into poorer countries. Brigham Buhler, a guest who talks about the drug industry, brings it up as an example of what drug makers have done, saying they "knowingly shipped a massive amount" of these drugs abroad. If true, it would mean a company knowingly sent tainted medicine to sick people.
